purpose: Training-side engineering check of canonical /R/ interval localization
selection: One canonical R; select 20 train speakers by SHA-256 of 20260923:speaker, then one eligible utterance per speaker by SHA-256 of 20260923:utterance
model: Existing pinned frozen WavLM-base-plus encoder and CMU Arctic automatic-phone-alignment linear CTC heads
canonicalMapping: Strip ARPAbet stress digit and lowercase; reject missing vocabulary tokens; no produced-phone inference
alignment: Exact Viterbi path constrained to full canonical phone sequence, with CTC blank and repeated-phone rules
interpretation: A forced path exists by construction when frames suffice. Flags measure internal support and head stability, not localization truth, produced phones, or clinical validity.
